verdict.rationale: While Productboard emphasizes closing the loop between specification, delivery, and outcome (productboard-docs-23) and offers rich APIs/integrations for pushing data to delivery tools, there is no evidence of a dedicated changelog/release-notes publishing feature for announcing shipped features to customers. Missing for 10: any mention of a customer-facing changelog or release-notes publishing tool, templates, or distribution channel (email, in-app, public page).
